status_definitions.faithful_translation: A complete human proof or explicit expansion of the precise cited source assertion under the stated finite hypotheses.
status_definitions.derived_simplification: An explicitly proved strengthening or shorter consequence with its source counterpart and unchanged application constants identified.
status_definitions.remaining_input: An unexpanded specialized input. No FG construction claim uses this status; global orbit abundance and numerical compatibility remain outside scope.

claims.title: Exact marked-cell, orbit-window and numerical hypotheses
claims.statement: OrbitHyp is expanded into the actual u, ell, M, G′, N1 and three finite conditions: short-window sparsity, cyclic marked-tile coverage and long-window cardinality. It implies u>=1, ell>0 and floor(n/ell)>M+1. The real delta is positive, with no further h/x restrictions needed for this finite consequence.
assumptions: n=n'>0 is even; r>=2; the actual application has L1>=1.
The explicitly expanded OrbitHyp, or the stated weaker OrbitRaw data, is supplied. No orbit-abundance premise is inferred from the construction.
claims.source_relation: Every finite premise is stated concretely. CondA counts all selected positions. Orbit abundance and asymptotic size supply are outside this theorem.

claims.title: All marked tiles in one periodic sequence, including the incomplete-period remainder
claims.statement: Sort all marked complete-tile indices s_a and define B_j=n floor(j/J)+ell*s_(j mod J). The next positive cyclic marked-index distance is <=M+1. The wrap adds exactly n-floor(n/ell)*ell, proving ell<=B_(j+1)-B_j<(M+2)ell, periodicity and coverage: the full bf_Seq statement.
assumptions: n=n'>0 is even; r>=2; the actual application has L1>=1.

claims.title: Unique lifted cell tops, parity, isolation and periodicity
claims.statement: Each marked tile has exactly 3r increasing even selected points a_(j,v) in [B_j+(2v+1)u,B_j+(2v+2)u). Every earlier selected point y satisfies y+u<a_(j,v); the analogous right gap also follows. The points shift by n after J tiles. No condition on selected points in unmarked tiles is added.
assumptions: n=n'>0 is even; r>=2; the actual application has L1>=1.

claims.source_relation: The period's evenness is used explicitly to preserve parity under all integer lifts; u is not assumed even. Cell uniqueness supplies the exact bf_tp choices.

claims.statement: The first r intermediate selected letters are the previous marked tile's final r tops; the last r are the current tile's first r. Thus every source endpoint is even and has gap>u>L2, as does the first current-frame entry. The physical segment span is strictly<(M+3)ell<=G′.

claims.title: Actual segment cardinality and strict oldest-even-predecessor separation
claims.statement: Reduction is injective on each integer half-open interval of length<=n. CondIntervals and the strict span give |W_j|<=N1. A late selected letter has at least r old-frame even predecessors; if its r-th most recent predecessor were within L1<=L2, the r predecessors would contradict CondA. The source's default-zero oldest branch is unused.
